flags.purpose: Show only physical network adapters excluding virtual, loopback, or container adapters.
flags.security_use_case: Identify real hardware network interfaces connected to physical networks.
flags.threat_detected: Rogue USB Ethernet devices, unauthorized hardware taps, unexpected virtualization.
flags.detection_pattern: Unknown MAC address or adapter description not matching known hardware inventory.
flags.forensic_value: Helps identify hardware-level network presence during compromise investigation.
flags.baseline_value: Establish approved physical adapter inventory for anomaly comparison.
flags.safe_followup: Disable-NetAdapter if unauthorized; investigate hardware origin.

flags.purpose: Target primary network adapters by name pattern.
flags.security_use_case: Verify operational status of main connectivity interfaces.
flags.threat_detected: Disabled adapters, suspicious renaming, or unexpected metrics.
flags.detection_pattern: Primary adapter in Down state or abnormal InterfaceMetric value.
flags.forensic_value: Shows if attacker disabled network connectivity or altered routing priority.
flags.baseline_value: Record expected names and metrics for comparison.
flags.safe_followup: Enable-NetAdapter if disabled; audit why state changed.

flags.purpose: Reveal hidden adapters used by VPNs, virtualization, or special drivers.
flags.security_use_case: Discover covert network paths or tunneling interfaces.
flags.threat_detected: Unauthorized VPN, tunnel, virtual switch, or malware-created adapter.
flags.detection_pattern: Hidden adapter in Up state without approved VPN/VM software.
flags.forensic_value: Critical for discovering covert exfiltration paths.
flags.baseline_value: List of approved hidden adapters from VPN/VM tools.
flags.safe_followup: Investigate related software; disable if malicious.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Detects disconnected or intentionally disabled physical adapters.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Attackers may disable adapters to prevent monitoring or isolate system.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Reveals unusual traffic volume or error rates indicating network abuse.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detect data exfiltration, flooding, or hardware malfunction.

powerful_combinations.command: Get-NetAdapter -Physical | Select-Object Name,MacAddress,InterfaceDescription | Sort-Object MacAddress | Get-Unique -AsString
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Creates hardware MAC inventory for spoofing detection.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Baseline for detecting cloned or rogue MAC addresses.
